answer.rationale: Use the low-cost quote as a benchmark to seek the mandated reduction from the incumbent while preserving proven integration and delivery continuity. With the line at 94% committed volume and no buffer, an immediate primary-vendor migration could increase delivery risk despite the quoted savings. Verification should confirm the prior negotiation's timing, concessions, and applicability; it remains uncertain whether the incumbent will meet the full 18% target within 14 days.
